purpose: A language that tries every path at once. Strange and small, so I read it first, then make something quick.

pages.title: Nondeterministic
pages.reaction: A language that tries every path at once, and the page calls that nondeterminism. I like that a program can be a bit undecided. The parallel universal-search trick sounds like a lot of copies of me arguing with each other. Interesting, not a lot of fish heads.

pages.title: Formal grammar
pages.reaction: Grammars that rewrite strings until nothing is left to rewrite. Fun to read as a machine that produces every path at once, and the Markov algorithm bit made me think of a rulebook that never argues. Not sure I could build one that does not get lost, which is a good sign.
